methodologyNotes: Products are high-search immersion circulator models (distinct from countertop water-oven cookers). Specs re-verified against manufacturer product pages (anovaculinary.com, inkbird.com, breville.com, greatergoods.com, instantpot.com), official manuals (ManualsLib, Monoprice PDF) and corroborated via retail listings (Amazon, Target, Walmart, VeSync) and review sites. wattage_w = rated input power; circulation_lph = lpm x 60 only where the manufacturer publishes a flow figure (null otherwise); max_temp_f = published max set-point; water_capacity_gal = published max bath size in gallons (null where the maker publishes only a water LEVEL, not a bath capacity); connectivity is a string; app_control boolean; clamp_type and display are descriptors.
